title: Modern Baseball Player Stats Dashboard
description: A responsive dashboard displaying baseball player statistics including batting average, home runs, RBIs, and recent game performance. Composed of a player profile card, stats table, and performance chart.

components.name: PlayerAvatar
components.description: Circular player headshot image with fallback initials placeholder

src.description: URL of the player's headshot image

alt.description: Accessible alt text for the player image

initials.description: Player initials shown as fallback when image is unavailable

layout.tailwind: relative flex items-center justify-center rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-gray-200 shrink-0

components.name: StatBadge
components.description: A small pill/badge component displaying a stat label and its value with color coding

layout.tailwind: inline-flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 py-2 rounded-xl gap-0.5

components.name: SectionHeading
components.description: Section title heading with optional subtitle

components.name: LoadingSpinner
components.description: Animated loading indicator used during data fetching states

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: Placeholder content shown when no data is available

icon.description: Icon name or emoji to display

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 py-16 text-center text-gray-400

components.name: PlayerProfileCard
components.description: Card showing the player's photo, name, team, position, jersey number, and key headline stats (AVG, HR, RBI). Acts as the identity section of the dashboard.

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center sm:items-start gap-6 p-6 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-md border border-gray-100 w-full

internalLayout.nameRow: flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-1 sm:gap-3

components.name: StatsTableRow
components.description: A single row in the player stats table representing one game or stat line

isHighlighted.description: Whether to visually highlight this row (e.g., notable performance)

layout.tailwind: grid grid-cols-7 items-center px-4 py-3 text-sm border-b border-gray-100 last:border-none hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors

components.name: PerformanceChartBar
components.description: A single vertical bar representing a game's batting performance in the chart (e.g., hits or batting average). Includes a tooltip on hover.

maxValue.description: Maximum possible value for scale normalization

label.description: X-axis label (e.g., date or game number)

tooltipText.description: Text shown in the hover tooltip

color.description: Tailwind background color class. Defaults to 'bg-blue-500'

isActive.description: Whether this bar is currently highlighted/selected

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col items-center justify-end gap-1 h-full

components.name: StatsTable
components.description: A full table displaying game-by-game batting statistics with sortable columns, a header row, and data rows for recent games. Includes an empty and loading state.

rows.description: Array of game stat objects (each matching StatsTableRow props)

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col w-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-md border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden

internalLayout.header: flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100
internalLayout.tableHeader: grid grid-cols-7 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider bg-gray-50

components.name: PerformanceChart
components.description: Bar chart visualising the player's recent game performance trend (e.g., hits or batting average over the last N games). Includes chart legend, axis labels, and hover tooltips.

data.description: Array of data point objects with { label, value } for each recent game

metric.description: The stat being plotted: 'hits' | 'homeRuns' | 'battingAverage'. Defaults to 'hits'

title.description: Chart title shown in the card header

maxGames.description: Maximum number of recent games to display. Defaults to 10

layout.tailwind: flex flex-col w-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-md border border-gray-100 p-6 gap-4

internalLayout.chartArea: relative flex items-end justify-between gap-1 h-48 mt-4
internalLayout.legend: flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2

components.name: DashboardTemplate
components.description: Defines the overall page layout grid for the dashboard: top profile card spanning full width, then a two-column layout with the performance chart and stats table below on larger screens.

isLoading.description: Propagates loading state to all child organisms

layout.tailwind: grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full

components.name: PlayerStatsDashboardPage
components.description: Top-level page component. Renders the page chrome (top navigation bar, page title) and the DashboardTemplate with all data-connected organisms.

playerId.description: Unique identifier for the player whose stats are displayed

internalLayout.navbar: w-full bg-white shadow-sm border-b border-gray-200 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-4 flex items-center justify-between

interactions.action: Row background transitions to gray-50 to indicate interactivity
Toggles sort direction (asc/desc) for the selected column; active column header shows sort arrow indicator
Bar scales up slightly (scale-105) and a tooltip appears above showing the date and exact stat value
Switches the chart data between 'Hits', 'Home Runs', and 'Batting Average' metrics; selected button gets primary color fill
All data-dependent sections display LoadingSpinner / skeleton placeholder while data is being fetched
An error banner is shown at the top of the page with a retry button; affected sections show EmptyState with an error message
Layout reflows: on mobile, PerformanceChart and StatsTable stack vertically; on lg+ screens they sit side by side in a two-column grid

responsiveBreakpoints.sm: 640px — single-column cards switch to row-direction player profile
responsiveBreakpoints.md: 768px — increased padding, stats badge font sizes grow
responsiveBreakpoints.lg: 1024px — DashboardTemplate switches bottom section to two-column grid
responsiveBreakpoints.xl: 1280px — max content width capped at max-w-7xl centered on page
